headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Revenue increased 4.0% QoQ from INR 58,539 cr, supported by healthy business momentum.
EBITDA increased 18.2% YoY to INR 34,946 cr, while EBITDA margin expanded 70 bps YoY to 57.4%, reflecting operating leverage and improved business mix.
Sequentially, EBITDA increased 4.9%, indicating sustained profitability improvement.
Overall, strong India and Africa profitability, enterprise growth and infrastructure investments supported performance, while Homes Services margin pressure remains a key monitorable.
valuation: Airtel Money Africa listed on the London Stock Exchange in October 2026 at approximately USD 7 bn valuation, strengthening visibility for its financial services business. • India Mobility and Subscriber Premiumisation: India mobile added 0.7 mn revenue-earning customers and 2.9 mn smartphone data customers.
watch: Overall, strong India and Africa profitability, enterprise growth and infrastructure investments supported performance, while Homes Services margin pressure remains a key monitorable.

ARPU increased to INR 271 from INR 264, partly benefiting from an additional calendar day. • Tariff Structure and ARPU Outlook: Management reiterated the need for structural pricing reforms, particularly monetising higher data consumption.
